label: Путь
description: Twelve-mission case drill for путь (way, path, route) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form путь is the subject of the sentence. This noun is unique: it is masculine yet declines almost entirely like a third-declension feminine, so most singular forms end in -и rather than the masculine endings.

Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The construction у плюс possession requires the genitive, giving пути. Following the third-declension feminine pattern, the genitive ending is -и rather than the masculine -а, hence пути.

Strategic focus: Dative singular. The adjective рады governs the dative, producing пути. Like a third-declension feminine, путь takes the dative ending -и, so the genitive, dative and prepositional singular all coincide as пути.
Strategic focus: Accusative singular. As the direct object of выбрал the inanimate noun copies the nominative, returning to путь. Accusative singular mirrors the nominative for this inanimate noun.

Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The noun in the instrumental, путём, means by this route. This is the one masculine exception in its declension: instead of the feminine -ью, путь takes the masculine instrumental ending -ём, the detail that betrays its true gender.

Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The preposition о (about) requires the prepositional case, giving пути. Following the third-declension feminine pattern, the ending is -и, so this form matches the genitive and dative as пути.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural subject takes пути. In the plural путь behaves like a regular soft masculine, so the nominative plural ending is -и, giving пути.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The negation нет requires the genitive plural путей. Here путь takes the masculine genitive plural ending -ей, so the plural diverges from its feminine-like singular pattern.

Strategic focus: Dative plural. The preposition по governs the dative, here the plural путям. The dative plural ending -ям attaches to the stem пут-, following the ordinary soft-masculine plural pattern.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. As the direct object of исследуют the inanimate noun copies the nominative plural, giving пути. The accusative equals the nominative for this inanimate noun in the plural.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The preposition между selects the instrumental plural путями. The ending -ями attaches to the stem пут-, the regular soft-masculine instrumental plural, with no feminine quirk in the plural.

Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The preposition на marks the prepositional plural путях. In the plural путь declines as an ordinary soft masculine, so the ending is -ях, unlike its feminine-leaning singular.
